content.short: Brand Connector is a simple website tool that lets brands customize content to any NFT in any wallet.
content.description: Brand Connector is a straightforward web tool that lets brands tailor content, offers, or rewards to NFTs in any user wallet. It creates a connection between NFTs and experiences or incentives through websites or loyalty programs, and facilitates partnerships between NFT collections and brands via a simple website bridge. The tool prompts users to verify NFT ownership and enables websites to personalize content based on ownership, making NFT assets more actionable across digital touchpoints.
